TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY NO. 03 FOR NORTH INDIAN OCEAN (THE BAY OF
BENGAL AND ARABIAN SEA) ISSUED AT 1700 UTC OF 01.11.2026 BASED ON 1500 UTC
OF 01.11.2026
Sub: Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu] over Southwest & adjoining Westcentral
Bay of Bengal.
The Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu]” over Southwest & adjoining Westcentral Bay of
Bengal moved west-northwestwards with speed of 25 kmph during past 6 hours and lay centered at 1500
UTC of today, the 01st November, 2026 over the Westcentral & adjoining Southwest Bay of Bengal near
Latitude 13.0°N and Longitude 83.4°E, about 350 km east of Chennai (Tamil Nadu,43279), 400 km east-
southeast of Nellore (Andhra Pradesh, 43245), 430 km southeast of Machilipatnam (Andhra Pradesh,
43185)), 420 east-southeast of Kavali (Andhra Pradesh, 43243), 450 km southeast of Ongole (Andhra
Pradesh, 43221) and 520 km south of Vishakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh, 43149).
It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify further into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over
Westcentral Bay of Bengal around 2100 UTC of 2nd November. Thereafter, it is very likely to move
northwestwards and cross south Andhra Pradesh coast as a Severe Cyclonic Storm with wind speed of
100 to 110 kmph gusting 120 kmph between Nellore(Andhra Pradesh, 43245) and Narsapur (Andhra
Pradesh, 43187) close to Ongole(Andhra Pradesh, 43221) during 1800-2200 UTC of 2nd November, 2026.
